messages:
lucas: Heads-up 1 HealthBridge RFI landed. They want a capability matrix, POC ops plan, deployment mapping (hosted / dedicated / private), and a 3-month pricing ballpark for 110M tokens/mo + 9k embeddings. 48h turnaround. Who can own what?

priya: Ill take the capability matrix. Procurement explicitly asked separate rows for quantization profiles, adaptive batching, KV caching, model fallback, SSO, and KMS. Keep rows short.

marcio: Ill draft the POC ops plan and the deployment comparison table. Will include canary example + rollback thresholds and a short note on running in customer cloud accounts.

esther: Quick pricing note: hosted 3-month ballpark for that load is roughly $26k-$34k depending on model family and prefix caching. Small dedicated reserved pool ~ $40k/mo commit or ~$24k/mo with burst credits. Finance to confirm.

lucas: Also need a one-page perf snapshot for 2k token context + ~512 token generation. Ben mentioned we have perf one-pagers for redwood-7b-quant and redwood-13b-8bit. Can someone attach that?

priya: Will export matrix as PDF and include a short row about "Automated fallback to compatible model variants (same API)" and separate rows for "Quantization support (8-bit / 4-bit)" and "Automated batching & KV caching".

marcio: Ops snippet to include in the runbook: 

```
route: healthbridge-poc
model: redwood-7b-quant
batching: adaptive
canary: {percent:5, duration:24h}
rollback: latency>2s || errors>1%
```

marcio: For model weights question: we do not distribute Redwood-managed performance weights. Open-catalog models can be shared per license; performance-tuned variants remain on our runtime. I'll add explicit RFI wording.

esther: For POC-in-customer-cloud: Hosted = no; Dedicated = possible with VPC peering / reserved nodes; Private = yes (VPC or on-prem). Add a short table.

priya: Security asks: KMS/BYOK, HSM for Private, SOC/ISO attachments, audit log retention (30/90/365 days). I'll attach our security appendix and a sentence: "Private deployments support customer-managed KMS (BYOK) and optional HSM integration."

lucas: Great. Priya, Marcio, can we target sending the bundle by tomorrow 08:30 PST? SummitHealth wanted 48h but HealthBridge marked EOD.

priya: Ill finish matrix tonight and export pdf.

marcio: Ill finalize the ops runbook and deployment note by 22:00 PT.

esther: Ill loop in Finance now for the POC discount approval and attach pricing_final.csv when they sign off.

rfi-bot: (uploaded) healthbridge_rfi_draft_v1.zip - capability_matrix.xlsx, rfi_answers.md, poc_ops_snippet.md, pricing_estimates.csv

lucas: Once finance confirms pricing and legal signs off on the RFI language, well send. Marking this thread for follow-up tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
